prompt: A landscape gardener was initially commissioned to plant a rectangular garden plot measuring 15 meters in length and 10 meters in width. The gardener's initial planting rate was 5 square meters per hour. Before starting, the client decided to revise the plan: the length of the garden would be increased by 20%, and the width would be decreased by 10%. Additionally, the gardener acquired new specialized tools which increased their planting efficiency by 25% compared to their original rate. What is the absolute difference, in hours, between the time it would have taken to plant the original garden and the time it will take to plant the revised garden?
